name: lsp
description: The lsp tool must send a whole source file to zls, which means pulling it through the host arena in one read. src/agent/loop.zig is over 100 KB; when the guest arena was 64 KiB this failed with 'could not read the file' while every build gate stayed green. Deliberately not position-sensitive: the assertion is that the tool answered at all, so the case survives the file being edited. Needs zls on PATH.
prompt: Use the lsp tool with action "definition" on file src/agent/loop.zig at line 100, character 4. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
